# Explainer V2 — engine guide for animators

Root `X = <scratchpad>/expl2`. Read `SPEC_V2.md` (brief + rules) and `final_storyboard.md` (what to build) first.
Vertical 1080×1920, 30 fps, everything drawn in Canvas 2D by `overlay/engine.html`, rendered deterministically by Chromium
(`overlay/render.mjs`). The engine is a fork of the Douane P1 « Kraft & Fil » engine (same kit, same look).

## Files (shared — do not edit unless your package owns it)
- `overlay/kit.js` — core: `W,H,FPS,C,FF`; maths `clamp, lerp, prog(t,a,b), eOutCubic, eInOutCubic, eOutExpo, eOutBack, spring(t,w,z), drop(t,t0,h0,dur), stepT(n), jit(id,n,amt), env(t,a,b,fin,fout), rnd(i)`;
  timeline `TL.ch(id) → {id,num,title,start,end}`, `TL.seg(id) → {start,end,words[{w,s,e}]}`, `TL.wt(seg, word, fb, nth)` (word start), `TL.we(...)` (word end), `TL.in(t, ch, a, b)`;
  drawing `withShadow(h,fn), rrect, at(x,y,r,sx,sy,fn), tornLine, text(s,x,y,{font,size,wght,color,align,alpha,ls,shadow}), font(fam,size,wght), measure, stampText(s,x,y,f,color,{box,starve,alpha}),
  carton(w,h,{tape,seam,label,grey,seed}), qr, shipLabel(w,h,'sea'|'air',code), iconShip, iconPlane, thread(pts,p,n,{w,color}), curve(ctrl,seg), ticket(w,h,title,sub,{done}), paperNote(x,y,w,h,rot,fn,o), drawLogo(x,y,size,{offsets,alpha}), scanner, laser, chip(x,y,label,{check,fill,color,size}), scaleDevice, tapeMeasure`.
  Fonts `FF.stencil` (Big Shoulders Stencil), `FF.body` (Bricolage Grotesque), `FF.mono` (Martian Mono), `FF.hand` (Shantell Sans), `FF.brand` (DM Sans), `FF.cjk`.
- `scenes/00_money.js` — `handText(s,x,y,size,{write,strike,color,align})`, `marker`, `handArrow(ctrl,p,col,w)`, `handCircle(rx,ry,p,col,w,seed)`, `postIt(w,fn,o)`, `plate(x,y,str,o)`, `notebook(w,h,o)`, `receipt`, `calculator`, `scissors`… (money props: not needed here).
- `scenes/01_people.js` — `person({...})` paper characters (use sparingly; NO real person is drawn).
- `scenes/02_director.js` — `captionHide((t,page)=>bool)`, `captionY((t,page)=>y|null)`: ask the caption strip to hide/move.
- `scenes/03_show.js` — `roundCard`, `commentBubble`, `dial`, `confetti(s,count,seed)`.
- `scenes/04_places.js` — `poly`, `paperBoat(cargo)`, `paperWaves(n,y0,amp,x0,x1,depth)`, `stall(w,o)`, `truck(t,o)`, `bendskin`.
- `scenes/05_video.js` — **real footage** (see below).
- `scenes/06_photo.js` — `photoCover`, `photoPrint`, `loupe(cx,cy,r,k,drawFn)`, `lightLeak(p,seed)`, `roundStamp(txt,center,r,color,o)`.
- `scenes/07_customs.js` — `docSheet`, `phoneFrame`, `fingerTap`, `DC` colours (customs-themed: avoid customs imagery here).
- `scenes/08_props.js` — `addShake(t0,amp,dur)` + `shake(t,n)`, `drift(t,seed,amp)`, `slam(t,t0,from)`, `pop(t,t0)`, `sack(w,h,label)`, `folder`, icons (`iconFactory, iconAnchor, iconClock, iconCheck, paperPlane`), `strip(txt,o)`, `stackBlock`.
- `scenes/09_map_data.js` — `window.BZ_MAP` (Natural Earth 1:50m, Mercator in 1/10° units): `land` rings, `china` rings, `dots`/`cdots` grid runs, `grid {x0,y0,step}`, `route` (sea route China → Gulf of Guinea, 1/100° units), `pts {origin, dest}`.
- `scenes/10_core.js` (lead, done) — storyboard §5.2 « 10_core.js »: `C.box/boxRib/boxIn/postit/halo`, `HP_PRINT, HP_PRINT_OUTRO, HP_FULL, NOTE`,
  `W_(seg,word,nth)` / `WE_` (word start/end, logs MISSING WORD), `hp_after, hp_hold, hp_map, vidBlend, hp_rectLerp, hp_pushRect, hp_frameToPrint,
  hp_printAt(rect, clip, srcT, {blend, drawOver, …videoPrint opts}), hp_halo(fn(col,w), w, col), hp_circle, hp_arrow, hp_scrap, hp_tagNote, hp_stamp
  (registry HP_STAMPS, auto shake + sfx), hp_check, hp_tape, hp_sfx(name, t0)` (→ `window._cues`, `render.mjs --dump-cues file`).
- `scenes/15_qrms.js` (generated by `lib/q_rms.py`) — `window.Q_RMS = {Q1:[…]…}` 0..1 per frame since `TL.seg(q).start`.
- **Camera shake is global**: `addShake(t0, amp, dur)` (or `hp_stamp`) shakes every scene with z < 62 automatically
  (engine). Never apply `shake()` yourself.
- `scenes/90_captions.js` — torn-paper captions (centre y 1340), spoken word highlighted violet. Don't draw in y 1250–1430 unless you move/hide captions.

## Real footage — `05_video.js`
Prepared frames `foot/up/<clip>/NNNNN.jpg` (AI-upscaled; carrier lettering removed) — only EVEN source frames exist: prints play on twos.
`render.mjs` loads what a frame needs automatically (probe pass) and falls back to 360p frames (`foot/lo`) while the upscale runs.
- `vid(clip, srcT)` → image or null. `CLIPS = {A:{fps:25}, B:{fps:30}, B2:{fps:30}}`. Forbidden ranges (`FORBID`) log `FORBIDDEN FOOTAGE`,
  the team AVOID list logs `AVOID FOOTAGE` (only exception: the B 9.0 still) — neither may appear in your render output.
- `vidT(t, t0, src0, speed, clip)` → source second (plays from src0 at speed since t0). Use `stepT(n)` instead of `t` for on-twos playback.
- `vidCover(clip, srcT, x, y, w, h, {fx, fy, zoom, grade:'warm'|'none'|'mono'|'duo', mirror})` — cover-fit frame (warm print grade by default).
- `videoPrint(clip, srcT, w, h, {border, lift, tape:true|'top'|false, caption, captionSize, develop, flash, gloss, curl, fx, fy, zoom, grade, scan(x,y,w,h), sprocket, pin})` — playing print centred at (0,0); call inside `at()`.
- `pushPin(x, y, col)`.
- `vidCutout(clip, srcT)` → `{canvas, scale, bbox}` (blue container keyed out, cached) and `drawCutout(cut, x, y, w, h, {fx, fy, zoom, lift, rim})` — the container lifting off the print as a sticker (map with the same framing as the print).
- `teamBadge(x, y, k, t, n, {live, label, sub, s, rot})` — « L'équipe Bonzini · sur place » kraft badge with a mic and a live waveform.

## Rules (summary — SPEC_V2.md wins)
1. One package = its own files `overlay/scenes/NN_name.js`, each an IIFE: `registerScene({ id, z, when: t => TL.in(t, 'ch', .5, .5), draw(t, n) })`.
   Global helpers you create must be prefixed with your package key (e.g. `s3_boat()`), to avoid collisions.
2. Deterministic: never Math.random / Date. Stop-motion = `stepT(n)` / `jit(id, n)`.
3. Everything anchored to words: `TL.wt('V05','bateau')`. The timeline will be swapped for the final one (same words) — no hard-coded seconds.
4. Safe zones: nothing in y < 150; nothing important in y > 1540; no text at x > 960 for y 900–1560; captions band y 1250–1430.
5. Readable text ≥ 44 px on opaque paper; titles ≥ 96 px; holds ≥ 2 s; ≤ 2 text blocks + caption.
6. Facts: SPEC_V2.md. No brands, no carrier names, no prices/delays/addresses (only « Foyer Balengou »).

## Check your work
```bash
cd $X/overlay
node render.mjs --scenes <your files> --times a,b,c --out ../out/chk_<key> --pages 2 --jpg
python3 ../lib/sheet.py ../out/chk_<key> ../out/chk_<key>_sheet.jpg 5
```
Look at every frame (Read tool) at full size and as a sheet; check the transitions in and out of your chapter (render the
neighbouring chapter's files too). CPU is shared (4 cores, several jobs): `--pages 2`, only the stills you need, `nice -n 5`.
